description:
HushMessenger v0.0.6 is a preview patch bundle. It adds the S25's Messenger 580.0.0.49.91 arm64 build (`346013440`) alongside the S22 build (`346013387`). Supply your own stock APK. The `.mpp` is a patch source, not an installable Messenger APK.

Both private stock APK copies patched and signed off-device with a test key. Android verified their APK v3 signatures, and each rebuilt manifest has the expected 26 plus three renamed permission entries. Altering the expected bytecode made the patch stop before output. Twelve unit tests passed, and two clean builds produced the same bundle checksum.

Phone behavior remains unverified. Both attached phones have stock Messenger in their only Android user, so their installed apps and local chat data were left untouched. Use a backed-up test session for login, chats, notifications and calls.

See the [README](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger#readme) for setup, supported APK hashes and recovery notes.
